question: By what means does one become perfected, and who has told this to whom?
premises: it was told by me to you
inference: The verse links perfection to devotion and frames the teaching as spoken by the deity to the devotee.
uncertainties: 'madbhaktyā' may mean devotion to me or my devotion
plain_english: One becomes perfected by devotion to me; this has been told by me to you.
